meta.name: prisma-compute
meta.description: Prisma Compute deployment and hosting guide. Use whenever the user mentions Prisma Compute, `prisma.compute.ts`, `defineComputeConfig`, deploying or hosting a Prisma app, `@prisma/cli app deploy`, `compute:deploy`, `create-prisma --deploy`, `PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN`, Compute auth/workspaces, apps/deployments/build logs/domains, localhost vs `0.0.0.0`, deploy port binding, or framework deploy readiness for Hono, Elysia, Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, Nuxt, Svelte, Nest, Turborepo, or custom/prebuilt artifacts.

copy.tagline: 把 Prisma 后端应用部署上线并管理运行配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在为 Prisma 应用配置部署和域名
copy.tagline_en: Deploy your Prisma backend app and manage its runtime config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're setting up deployment and domains for a Prisma app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会指导你把 Prisma 应用部署到 Prisma Compute:先检查项目配置与脚本,再给出对应的 @prisma/cli 部署命令;同时处理登录认证、工作区、框架就绪性和端口绑定,出错时引导排查并可通过反馈命令上报。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Prisma Compute、prisma.compute.ts,或要求部署/托管 Prisma 应用时触发;其他相关关键词(如 PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN、框架就绪性)等也会命中。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Next.js 项目部署到 Prisma Compute
say.note: Claude 会检查配置并给出部署命令。

say.text: 我的 app deploy 报错了,帮我排查一下
say.note: 它会按决策树引导你解决,必要时让你反馈。

say.text: 用 create-prisma 新建一个可部署的项目
say.note: 它会生成脚手架并配置 compute:deploy 脚本。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through deploying Prisma apps to Compute: inspects project config, gives CLI commands, handles auth/workspaces/framework readiness/port binding, and troubleshoots errors with an optional feedback report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Prisma Compute, prisma.compute.ts, or deploying/hosting a Prisma app; also for related keywords like PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN or framework readiness.

say_en.text: Help me deploy this Next.js project to Prisma Compute.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect config and suggest deploy commands.

say_en.text: My app deploy is failing, help me debug it.
say_en.note: It follows the decision tree and may suggest feedback.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new Prisma Compute project with create-prisma.
say_en.note: Generates the project and configures the compute:deploy script.
